maintenance_led.reason: Sells disposable single-use medical devices (catheters, embolics, stents, inflation devices) for new procedures, not servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells to hospitals and healthcare systems worldwide, paid mostly by mixed private and public payers; no majority government funding evident.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own product development, sales and education; makes only occasional tuck-in acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated, physician-trained devices used in cath lab and interventional procedures; switching needs clinician retraining, product validation and hospital approval.

notes: Public funding is mixed (hospitals paid by government and private insurers), so that answer is a judgment call.
